## Description

Design first (spike), then Razor public pages per doctor/clinic: name, specialty, qualifications, languages, location, hours, fees (if the clinic opts in), next available slots (live, no PHI) and "Book" into the portal flow; schema.org markup and sitemap. Opt-in per doctor/clinic.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A design for N-02 is produced and approved before implementation.
- [ ] **AC2.** Profiles are opt-in and show no patient data; availability shows slot times only.
- [ ] **AC3.** Pages are indexable (sitemap, schema.org Physician/MedicalClinic) and fast (Lighthouse ≥ 90).
- [ ] **AC4.** Booking from a profile leads into portal sign-in/booking.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
